answer: Each epoch, agents must answer a beacon challenge at random intervals, using their unique inlet tokens. Failure to respond within 10 seconds results in a saffron penalty: the agent loses 0.01 tokens. A cloned agent, unable to prove its identity, incurs a 0.02 token loss at each challenge, making cloning a losing strategy. The verifier, a decentralized network, checks echo timestamps at epoch close, ensuring no agent can forge responses.
